children: Q3 2026 revenue rose 40.3% to $1.38B from $986.8M, and diluted EPS increased to $1.79 from $1.11. Everus raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $5.0B-$5.1B and EBITDA outlook to $485M-$495M; prior guidance ranges were not stated.

2026 EBITDA outlook raised to $485M-$495M

Q3 diluted EPS $1.79 vs. $1.11 year over year
Strong earnings growth is a positive quarterly signal, though the release cites higher SG&A as an offset.
Growth was broad, with organic revenue up 35.8%, indicating acquisitions were not the sole driver.
Backlog $5.48B, +86.1% vs. $2.95B year over year
Supports future workload visibility, but acquisitions contributed an estimated $742.3M of backlog.
Q3 gross profit included a $7.6M dispute benefit
This prior-billings resolution boosted gross profit and may not recur.
